verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes official OpenAPI-compliant REST API specifications along with first-party Postman collections. These give users a machine-readable reference and requests they can actually run, though only after importing them into Postman. Nothing shows an in-docs interactive API explorer with try-it or runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec served at the standard docs paths (all 404). missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API reference with runnable examples, a spec discoverable from the docs site, independent or hands-on corroboration that the collections run as intended.
